# Ileana Prince

> UX/UI designer and associate engineer in Orlando, Florida. Human-centered
> design, accessibility, and interface systems. B.S. in User Experience Design,
> Full Sail University.

Contact: ileanaprince@icloud.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/ileanaprince/

## Selected work

- [Local Roots](https://ileanaprince.com/work/local-roots.html): Her own app concept,
  invented and built from scratch over four months in 2025. An AI-assisted app for
  sustainable farming. Field interviews with farmers, three personas spanning beginner
  to large-scale, information architecture built from nothing, a high-fidelity Figma
  prototype, and usability testing with five participants across eight tasks, with two
  rounds of changes fed back into the design.
- [Ulta Beauty AR](https://ileanaprince.com/work/ulta-beauty.html): A four-week 2024
  concept for augmented reality in-store wayfinding across a 1,380-store retailer.
  Directions to a product, similar-item fallbacks when something is sold out, and a
  call-an-associate button. Includes research on whether AR suits the demographic, a
  task flow, a style guide, and high-fidelity mockups. Not yet user-tested; the page
  states what would be measured.
- [Keep > Going](https://ileanaprince.com/work/keep-going.html): A self-directed 2024
  project designing a role-aware operations dashboard for a small first-aid company —
  separate views for distribution, customer service, and sales on a shared structure.
- [iOS Mobile Toolkit](https://ileanaprince.com/work/ios-toolkit.html): A December 2024
  design reference for iOS covering spacing and safe areas, typography minimums,
  44-point hit targets, and an accessibility checklist.
- [Exploring the Docs: Xbox](https://ileanaprince.com/work/xbox.html): A usability study
  reading the Xbox developer documentation as an interface.
- [Better Homes & Gardens](https://ileanaprince.com/work/better-homes-gardens.html): A
  responsive study of a content-heavy editorial site. Case study in progress.
- [Starbucks empathy study](https://ileanaprince.com/work/starbucks.html): A persona and
  empathy map on what service inconsistency does to a loyal customer.

## Skills

Figma, FigJam, Adobe XD, Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Sketch, InVision, Canva.
Human-centered design, HCI/HMI principles, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing,
A/B testing, WCAG accessibility, journey and process mapping, interaction design.
Agile/Scrum, stakeholder presentations, Salesforce CRM.
